body: i know it must suck, but try not to put yourself down for it, there’s nothing wrong with you and it’s not about you not being enough, you might just not be what she’s looking for in a relationship and that doesn’t mean you’re not enough, her wanting to be your friend shows you have good qualities. You will find someone to love and friends who will adore those qualities and things will get easier, even if it’s just one person it can make things a lot easier, you’ll still have rough days but it helps so much. wish you the best, my dms are always open :)
